sanskrit: nāsti lokeṣu tad bhūtaṃ bhavitā no bhaviṣyati yo jayet pāṇḍavān saṃkhye pālitāñ śārṅgadhanvanā
english: There is no being in all the worlds, none now nor any yet to come, who could conquer in battle the Pāṇḍavas while they are guarded by the bearer of the Śārṅga bow.

sanskrit: yat tu me kathitaṃ tāta munibhir bhāvitātmabhiḥ purāṇagītaṃ dharmajña tac chṛṇuṣva yathātatham
english: But hear faithfully, O knower of dharma, that which was sung of old and told to me, my son, by sages of disciplined souls.

sanskrit: purā kila surāḥ sarve ṛṣayaś ca samāgatāḥ pitāmaham upāseduḥ parvate gandhamādane
english: In ancient times, it is said, all the gods and the seers, gathered together, waited upon the Grandsire upon the mountain Gandhamādana.

sanskrit: madhye teṣāṃ samāsīnaḥ prajāpatir apaśyata vimānaṃ jājvalad bhāsā sthitaṃ pravaram ambare
english: Seated in their midst, Prajāpati beheld a celestial chariot, blazing with radiance, most excellent, poised in the sky.

sanskrit: dhyānenāvedya taṃ brahmā kṛtvā ca niyato 'ñjalim namaścakāra hṛṣṭātmā paramaṃ parameśvaram
english: Discerning him through meditation, Brahmā, with self-controlled and gladdened heart, joined his palms and bowed before the supreme Lord of lords.

sanskrit: ṛṣayas tv atha devāś ca dṛṣṭvā brahmāṇam utthitam sthitāḥ prāñjalayaḥ sarve paśyanto mahad adbhutam
english: Then the seers and the gods, seeing Brahmā risen, all stood with palms joined, gazing upon the great marvel.

sanskrit: yathāvac ca tam abhyarcya brahmā brahmavidāṃ varaḥ jagāda jagataḥ sraṣṭā paraṃ paramadharmavit
english: Having worshipped him duly, Brahmā—best of the knowers of Brahman, creator of the world, supreme knower of the highest dharma—spoke to that Supreme One.

sanskrit: viśvāvasur viśvamūrtir viśveśo; viṣvakseno viśvakarmā vaśī ca viśveśvaro vāsudevo 'si tasmād; yogātmānaṃ daivataṃ tvām upaimi
english: You are the wealth of all, the form of all, the lord of all; Viṣvaksena, maker of all, the self-controlled, the sovereign of the universe, Vāsudeva. Therefore I take refuge in you, the divine, whose essence is yoga.

sanskrit: jaya viśva mahādeva jaya lokahite rata jaya yogīśvara vibho jaya yogaparāvara
english: Victory to you, O Universe, great God! Victory, you who delight in the welfare of the worlds! Victory, O sovereign master of yoga, all-pervading One! Victory, you who are both the near and the far of yoga!

sanskrit: padmagarbha viśālākṣa jaya lokeśvareśvara bhūtabhavyabhavan nātha jaya saumyātmajātmaja
english: O lotus-wombed, wide-eyed One, victory to you, Lord of the lords of the worlds! O master of what has been, what shall be, and what is, victory to you, son of a gentle-souled father's son!

sanskrit: asaṃkhyeyaguṇājeya jaya sarvaparāyaṇa nārāyaṇa suduṣpāra jaya śārṅgadhanurdhara
english: O One of countless virtues, unconquerable, victory to you, final refuge of all! O Nārāyaṇa, hard to fathom, victory to you, bearer of the Śārṅga bow!

sanskrit: sarvaguhyaguṇopeta viśvamūrte nirāmaya viśveśvara mahābāho jaya lokārthatatpara
english: O One endowed with every secret excellence, O form of the universe, the flawless, O lord of all, mighty-armed One, victory to you, intent upon the good of the worlds!

sanskrit: mahoraga varāhādya harikeśa vibho jaya harivāsa viśāmīśa viśvāvāsāmitāvyaya
english: O great serpent, primeval Boar, tawny-haired, all-pervading One, victory to you, dwelling-place of Hari, lord of the peoples, abode of the universe, boundless and undecaying!

sanskrit: vyaktāvyaktāmitasthāna niyatendriya sendriya asaṃkhyeyātmabhāvajña jaya gambhīra kāmada
english: O One whose station is the manifest, the unmanifest, and the immeasurable, governing the senses yet possessed of senses, knower of the countless states of the soul—victory to you, profound One, granter of desires!

sanskrit: ananta viditaprajña nityaṃ bhūtavibhāvana kṛtakārya kṛtaprajña dharmajña vijayājaya
english: O endless One of perfect wisdom, ever the illuminator of beings, you whose work is accomplished, whose wisdom is fulfilled, knower of dharma, the victor and the unvanquished!

sanskrit: guhyātman sarvabhūtātman sphuṭasaṃbhūtasaṃbhava bhūtārthatattva lokeśa jaya bhūtavibhāvana
english: O hidden Self, Self of all beings, source from which manifest creation springs forth, truth of the real meaning of things, lord of the worlds—victory to you, illuminator of beings!

sanskrit: ātmayone mahābhāga kalpasaṃkṣepatatpara udbhāvana manodbhāva jaya brahmajanapriya
english: O self-born, greatly blessed One, intent upon the dissolution of the aeon, the bringer-forth, born of the mind—victory to you, beloved of the people of Brahman!

sanskrit: nisargasargābhirata kāmeśa parameśvara amṛtodbhava sadbhāva yugāgne vijayaprada
english: O One who delights in the outpouring of creation, lord of desire, supreme Lord, source of the nectar of immortality, the truly existent, fire at the ages' end—giver of victory!

sanskrit: prajāpatipate deva padmanābha mahābala ātmabhūta mahābhūta karmātmañ jaya karmada
english: O lord of the lords of creatures, divine One, lotus-naveled, of great might, self-existent, mighty being, whose very essence is action—victory to you, granter of the fruits of action!

sanskrit: pādau tava dharā devī diśo bāhur divaṃ śiraḥ mūrtis te 'haṃ surāḥ kāyaś candrādityau ca cakṣuṣī
english: The goddess Earth is your two feet, the quarters your arms, heaven your head; I am your form, the gods your body, the moon and sun your two eyes.

sanskrit: balaṃ tapaś ca satyaṃ ca dharmaḥ kāmātmajaḥ prabho tejo 'gniḥ pavanaḥ śvāsa āpas te svedasaṃbhavāḥ
english: Strength, austerity, truth, and dharma are yours, O Lord, and Desire your offspring; fire is your splendour, the wind your breath, and the waters are sprung from your sweat.

sanskrit: aśvinau śravaṇau nityaṃ devī jihvā sarasvatī vedāḥ saṃskāraniṣṭhā hi tvayīdaṃ jagad āśritam
english: The Aśvins are forever your two ears, the goddess Sarasvatī your tongue, the Vedas grounded in your sacraments—for upon you this whole world rests.

sanskrit: na saṃkhyāṃ na parīmāṇaṃ na tejo na parākramam na balaṃ yogayogīśa jānīmas te na saṃbhavam
english: Neither your number nor your measure, neither your splendour nor your prowess, nor your strength do we know, O lord of yoga and of yogins, nor your origin.

sanskrit: tvadbhaktiniratā deva niyamais tvā samāhitāḥ arcayāmaḥ sadā viṣṇo parameśaṃ maheśvaram
english: Devoted to your worship, O God, composed through our observances, we ever adore you, O Viṣṇu, the supreme Lord, the great Lord.

sanskrit: ṛṣayo devagandharvā yakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ piśācā mānuṣāś caiva mṛgapakṣisarīsṛpāḥ
english: The seers, gods, and gandharvas, the yakṣas, rākṣasas, and serpents, the piśācas and the humans, beasts, birds, and creeping things—

sanskrit: evamādi mayā sṛṣṭaṃ pṛthivyāṃ tvatprasādajam padmanābha viśālākṣa kṛṣṇa duḥsvapnanāśana
english: all this and more I have created upon the earth, born of your grace, O lotus-naveled, wide-eyed Kṛṣṇa, destroyer of evil dreams.

sanskrit: tvaṃ gatiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tvaṃ netā tvaṃ jaganmukham tvatprasādena deveśa sukhino vibudhāḥ sadā
english: You are the goal of all beings, you the guide, you the face of the world; by your grace, O lord of the gods, the wise are forever happy.

sanskrit: pṛthivī nirbhayā deva tvatprasādāt sadābhavat tasmād bhava viśālākṣa yaduvaṃśavivardhanaḥ
english: By your grace, O God, the earth has ever been free from fear; therefore become, O wide-eyed One, the increaser of the lineage of the Yadus.

sanskrit: dharmasaṃsthāpanārthāya daiteyānāṃ vadhāya ca jagato dhāraṇārthāya vijñāpyaṃ kuru me prabho
english: For the firm establishment of dharma, for the slaying of the sons of Diti, and for the upholding of the world—heed my prayer, O Lord.

sanskrit: yad etat paramaṃ guhyaṃ tvatprasādamayaṃ vibho vāsudeva tad etat te mayodgītaṃ yathātatham
english: This supreme mystery, made wholly of your grace, O all-pervading Vāsudeva, has been faithfully sung by me to you.

sanskrit: sṛṣṭvā saṃkarṣaṇaṃ devaṃ svayam ātmānam ātmanā kṛṣṇa tvam ātmanāsrākṣīḥ pradyumnaṃ cātmasaṃbhavam
english: Having brought forth the god Saṃkarṣaṇa, your own self by your self, O Kṛṣṇa, you by yourself created Pradyumna, sprung from yourself.

sanskrit: pradyumnāc cāniruddhaṃ tvaṃ yaṃ vidur viṣṇum avyayam aniruddho 'sṛjan māṃ vai brahmāṇaṃ lokadhāriṇam
english: And from Pradyumna you created Aniruddha, whom they know as the imperishable Viṣṇu; and Aniruddha created me, Brahmā, the upholder of the worlds.

sanskrit: vāsudevamayaḥ so 'haṃ tvayaivāsmi vinirmitaḥ vibhajya bhāgaśo ''tmānaṃ vraja mānuṣatāṃ vibho
english: Thus I, made of Vāsudeva, have been fashioned by you alone. Dividing your self into portions, take birth in the estate of man, O all-pervading One.

sanskrit: tatrāsuravadhaṃ kṛtvā sarvalokasukhāya vai dharmaṃ sthāpya yaśaḥ prāpya yogaṃ prāpsyasi tattvataḥ
english: There, slaying the asuras for the happiness of all the worlds, establishing dharma and winning renown, you shall attain yoga in its very truth.

sanskrit: tvāṃ hi brahmarṣayo loke devāś cāmitavikrama tais taiś ca nāmabhir bhaktā gāyanti paramātmakam
english: For the brahmin-seers in the world, and the gods too, O One of measureless might, devoted, sing of you by those many names, of you whose essence is the Supreme Self.

sanskrit: sthitāś ca sarve tvayi bhūtasaṃghāḥ; kṛtvāśrayaṃ tvāṃ varadaṃ subāho anādimadhyāntam apārayogaṃ; lokasya setuṃ pravadanti viprāḥ
english: All the hosts of beings abide in you, taking refuge in you, the granter of boons, O fair-armed One; the wise declare you to be without beginning, middle, or end, of boundless yoga, the bridge of the world.

sanskrit: bhīṣma uvāca tataḥ sa bhagavān devo lokānāṃ parameśvaraḥ brahmāṇaṃ pratyuvācedaṃ snigdhagambhīrayā girā
english: Bhīṣma said: Then that blessed God, supreme Lord of the worlds, answered Brahmā thus, in a voice tender and deep.

sanskrit: viditaṃ tāta yogān me sarvam etat tavepsitam tathā tad bhavitety uktvā tatraivāntaradhīyata
english: "Through yoga, my son, all that you desire is known to me; so shall it be"—and saying this, he vanished then and there.

sanskrit: tato devarṣigandharvā vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ kautūhalaparāḥ sarve pitāmaham athābruvan
english: Then the gods, seers, and gandharvas, filled with the utmost wonder and consumed by curiosity, all spoke to the Grandsire.

sanskrit: ko nv ayaṃ yo bhagavatā praṇamya vinayād vibho vāgbhiḥ stuto variṣṭhābhiḥ śrotum icchāma taṃ vayam
english: "Who is this, O all-pervading Lord, to whom you have bowed with humility and praised with the most excellent of words? We desire to hear of him."

sanskrit: evam uktas tu bhagavān pratyuvāca pitāmahaḥ devabrahmarṣigandharvān sarvān madhurayā girā
english: Thus addressed, the blessed Grandsire answered all the gods, the brahmin-seers, and the gandharvas in a gentle voice.

sanskrit: yat tatparaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca bhavitavyaṃ ca yat param bhūtātmā yaḥ prabhuś caiva brahma yac ca paraṃ padam
english: "That which is the supreme, that which is to come and that which must be, who is the Self of beings and the Lord, and who is the Brahman, the highest abode—

sanskrit: tenāsmi kṛtasaṃvādaḥ prasannena surarṣabhāḥ jagato 'nugrahārthāya yācito me jagatpatiḥ
english: with him, gracious, did I hold this converse, O bulls among gods; for the blessing of the world I implored the Lord of the universe.

sanskrit: mānuṣaṃ lokam ātiṣṭha vāsudeva iti śrutaḥ asurāṇāṃ vadhārthāya saṃbhavasva mahītale
english: 'Take your stand in the world of men, known as Vāsudeva; for the slaying of the asuras, be born upon the earth.'

sanskrit: saṃgrāme nihatā ye te daityadānavarākṣasāḥ ta ime nṛṣu saṃbhūtā ghorarūpā mahābalāḥ
english: Those daityas, dānavas, and rākṣasas who were slain in battle have now been born among men, terrible in form and of great strength.

sanskrit: teṣāṃ vadhārthaṃ bhagavān nareṇa sahito vaśī mānuṣīṃ yonim āsthāya cariṣyati mahītale
english: For their slaying, the self-controlled Lord, together with Nara, taking on a human birth, shall walk upon the earth.

sanskrit: naranārāyaṇau yau tau purāṇāv ṛṣisattamau sahitau mānuṣe loke saṃbhūtāv amitadyutī
english: Nara and Nārāyaṇa, those two most ancient and excellent of seers, of measureless splendour, have together been born into the world of men.

sanskrit: ajeyau samare yattau sahitāv amarair api mūḍhās tv etau na jānanti naranārāyaṇāv ṛṣī
english: Unconquerable in battle when they strive together, even by the immortals—yet the foolish do not recognize these two seers, Nara and Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit: tasyāham ātmajo brahmā sarvasya jagataḥ patiḥ vāsudevo 'rcanīyo vaḥ sarvalokamaheśvaraḥ
english: I, Brahmā, lord of all the world, am his son; Vāsudeva, the great Lord of all the worlds, is the One worthy of your worship.

sanskrit: tathā manuṣyo 'yam iti kadā cit surasattamāḥ nāvajñeyo mahāvīryaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ
english: Never, O best of gods, is the One of mighty valour, bearer of conch, discus, and mace, to be slighted with the thought, 'This is but a man.'

sanskrit: etat paramakaṃ guhyam etat paramakaṃ padam etat paramakaṃ brahma etat paramakaṃ yaśaḥ
english: This is the supreme mystery, this the supreme abode, this the supreme Brahman, this the supreme glory.

sanskrit: etad akṣaram avyaktam etat tac chāśvataṃ mahat etat puruṣasaṃjñaṃ vai gīyate jñāyate na ca
english: This is the imperishable, the unmanifest, this the eternal and the great; this, named Puruṣa, is sung of yet not known.

sanskrit: etat paramakaṃ teja etat paramakaṃ sukham etat paramakaṃ satyaṃ kīrtitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā
english: This is the supreme splendour, this the supreme bliss, this the supreme truth, proclaimed by the Maker of all.

sanskrit: tasmāt sarvaiḥ suraiḥ sendrair lokaiś cāmitavikramaḥ nāvajñeyo vāsudevo mānuṣo 'yam iti prabhuḥ
english: Therefore the Lord of measureless might, Vāsudeva, must never be slighted by any of the gods with Indra, nor by the worlds, with the thought, 'This is but a man.'

sanskrit: yaś ca mānuṣamātro 'yam iti brūyāt sumandadhīḥ hṛṣīkeśam avajñānāt tam āhuḥ puruṣādhamam
english: And whoever, dull of wit, should say of Hṛṣīkeśa in contempt, 'This is no more than a man,' him they call the basest of men.

sanskrit: yoginaṃ taṃ mahātmānaṃ praviṣṭaṃ mānuṣīṃ tanum avamanyed vāsudevaṃ tam āhus tāmasaṃ janāḥ
english: Whoever should despise that great-souled yogin, Vāsudeva, entered into a human body, him people call a man steeped in darkness.

sanskrit: devaṃ carācarātmānaṃ śrīvatsāṅkaṃ suvarcasam padmanābhaṃ na jānāti tam āhus tāmasaṃ janāḥ
english: Whoever does not recognize the divine Self of all that moves and is still, marked with the Śrīvatsa, radiant, the lotus-naveled One—him people call steeped in darkness.

sanskrit: kirīṭakaustubhadharaṃ mitrāṇām abhayaṃkaram avajānan mahātmānaṃ ghore tamasi majjati
english: Whoever scorns that great-souled One, who wears the diadem and the Kaustubha gem and grants safety to his friends, sinks into terrible darkness.

sanskrit: evaṃ viditvā tattvārthaṃ lokānām īśvareśvaraḥ vāsudevo namaskāryaḥ sarvalokaiḥ surottamāḥ
english: Knowing thus the truth of the matter, Vāsudeva, Lord of the lords of the worlds, is to be revered by all the worlds, O best of gods."

sanskrit: evam uktvā sa bhagavān sarvān devagaṇān purā visṛjya sarvalokātmā jagāma bhavanaṃ svakam
english: Having spoken thus to all the hosts of gods long ago, that blessed One, the Self of all the worlds, dismissed them and went to his own abode.

sanskrit: tato devāḥ sagandharvā munayo 'psaraso 'pi ca kathāṃ tāṃ brahmaṇā gītāṃ śrutvā prītā divaṃ yayuḥ
english: Then the gods with the gandharvas, the sages and the apsarases, having heard that discourse sung by Brahmā, went gladdened to heaven.

sanskrit: etac chrutaṃ mayā tāta ṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām vāsudevaṃ kathayatāṃ samavāye purātanam
english: This I heard, my son, in an assembly of seers of disciplined souls as they told the ancient tale of Vāsudeva.

sanskrit: jāmadagnyasya rāmasya mārkaṇḍeyasya dhīmataḥ vyāsanāradayoś cāpi śrutaṃ śrutaviśārada
english: From Rāma the son of Jamadagni, from the wise Mārkaṇḍeya, and from Vyāsa and Nārada too I have heard it, O master of sacred lore.

sanskrit: etam arthaṃ ca vijñāya śrutvā ca prabhum avyayam vāsudevaṃ mahātmānaṃ lokānām īśvareśvaram
english: Having understood this truth and heard of the imperishable Lord, the great-souled Vāsudeva, Lord of the lords of the worlds—

sanskrit: yasyāsāv ātmajo brahmā sarvasya jagataḥ pitā kathaṃ na vāsudevo 'yam arcyaś cejyaś ca mānavaiḥ
english: he whose son is Brahmā, the father of all the world—how then should this Vāsudeva not be worshipped and adored by men?

sanskrit: vārito 'si purā tāta munibhir vedapāragaiḥ mā gaccha saṃyugaṃ tena vāsudevena dhīmatā mā pāṇḍavaiḥ sārdham iti tac ca mohān na budhyase
english: Of old, my son, you were warned by sages versed to the depths of the Vedas: 'Go not to war against that wise Vāsudeva, nor against the Pāṇḍavas'—yet in your delusion you do not heed it.

sanskrit: manye tvāṃ rākṣasaṃ krūraṃ tathā cāsi tamovṛtaḥ yasmād dviṣasi govindaṃ pāṇḍavaṃ ca dhanaṃjayam naranārāyaṇau devau nānyo dviṣyād dhi mānavaḥ
english: I deem you a cruel rākṣasa, and so you are, shrouded in darkness, since you hate Govinda and the Pāṇḍava Dhanaṃjaya—the divine Nara and Nārāyaṇa, whom no other man would hate.

sanskrit: tasmād bravīmi te rājann eṣa vai śāśvato 'vyayaḥ sarvalokamayo nityaḥ śāstā dhātā dharo dhruvaḥ
english: Therefore I tell you, O king: he is indeed the eternal and imperishable One, made of all the worlds, the everlasting, the ruler, the sustainer, the upholder, the unshaken.

sanskrit: lokān dhārayate yas trīṃś carācaraguruḥ prabhuḥ yoddhā jayaś ca jetā ca sarvaprakṛtir īśvaraḥ
english: He who upholds the three worlds, the Lord and teacher of all that moves and is still, the warrior, the victory, and the victor, the source of all nature, the sovereign—

sanskrit: rājan sattvamayo hy eṣa tamorāgavivarjitaḥ yataḥ kṛṣṇas tato dharmo yato dharmas tato jayaḥ
english: O king, he is made of pure goodness, free of darkness and of passion; where Kṛṣṇa is, there is dharma, and where dharma is, there is victory.

sanskrit: tasya māhātmyayogena yogenātmana eva ca dhṛtāḥ pāṇḍusutā rājañ jayaś caiṣāṃ bhaviṣyati
english: By the power of his greatness and by the yoga of his very self, the sons of Pāṇḍu are sustained, O king, and victory shall be theirs.

sanskrit: śreyoyuktāṃ sadā buddhiṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ dadhāti yaḥ balaṃ caiva raṇe nityaṃ bhayebhyaś caiva rakṣati
english: He who ever bestows upon the Pāṇḍavas a mind set on what is good, and gives them strength in battle always, and guards them from all dangers—

sanskrit: sa eṣa śāśvato devaḥ sarvaguhyamayaḥ śivaḥ vāsudeva iti jñeyo yan māṃ pṛcchasi bhārata
english: this is that eternal God, made of all mysteries, the auspicious One, to be known as Vāsudeva, of whom you ask me, O Bhārata.

sanskrit: brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyair vaiśyaiḥ śūdraiś ca kṛtalakṣaṇaiḥ sevyate 'bhyarcyate caiva nityayuktaiḥ svakarmabhiḥ
english: By brāhmaṇas, kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, and śūdras, each bearing his own marks, ever devoted to their proper duties, he is served and worshipped.

sanskrit: dvāparasya yugasyānte ādau kaliyugasya ca sātvataṃ vidhim āsthāya gītaḥ saṃkarṣaṇena yaḥ
english: At the end of the Dvāpara age and the beginning of the Kali age, he was hymned by Saṃkarṣaṇa according to the Sātvata rite.

sanskrit: sa eṣa sarvāsuramartyalokaṃ; samudrakakṣyāntaritāḥ purīś ca yuge yuge mānuṣaṃ caiva vāsaṃ; punaḥ punaḥ sṛjate vāsudevaḥ
english: It is he, Vāsudeva, who age after age brings forth anew the whole world of asuras and of mortals, and the cities girt within the ocean's bounds, and his own dwelling among men, again and again.

sanskrit: duryodhana uvāca vāsudevo mahad bhūtaṃ sarvalokeṣu kathyate tasyāgamaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ ca jñātum icche pitāmaha
english: Duryodhana said: Vāsudeva is spoken of in all the worlds as a great being. I wish to know his origin and his abiding ground, O Grandsire.

sanskrit: bhīṣma uvāca vāsudevo mahad bhūtaṃ saṃbhūtaṃ saha daivataiḥ na paraṃ puṇḍarīkākṣād dṛśyate bharatarṣabha mārkaṇḍeyaś ca govindaṃ kathayaty adbhutaṃ mahat
english: Bhīṣma said: Vāsudeva is a great being, born together with the gods. Nothing higher than the lotus-eyed One is to be seen, O bull of the Bharatas; and Mārkaṇḍeya too tells of Govinda the wondrous and the mighty.

sanskrit: sarvabhūtāni bhūtātmā mahātmā puruṣottamaḥ āpo vāyuś ca tejaś ca trayam etad akalpayat
english: The Self of beings, the great-souled Supreme Person, fashioned all beings, and these three—the waters, the wind, and fire.

sanskrit: sa sṛṣṭvā pṛthivīṃ devaḥ sarvalokeśvaraḥ prabhuḥ apsu vai śayanaṃ cakre mahātmā puruṣottamaḥ sarvatoyamayo devo yogāt suṣvāpa tatra ha
english: Having created the earth, that divine Lord of all the worlds, the great-souled Supreme Person, made his couch upon the waters; and the God, made wholly of the waters, slept there through the power of yoga.
